thread.title: Today’s Research Reports on Stocks to Watch: Apple and Twitter

author: Accesswire
title: Today’s Research Reports on Stocks to Watch: Apple and Twitter
text:
https://rdinvesting.com/news/?ticker=TWTR 
Apple Inc. shares closed down a little over 4% on Friday and finished the week down roughly 6%. Shares of the tech giant were sliding last week after analysts had lowered their forecasts for iPhone sales. Morgan Stanley analyst Katy Huberty who has covered Apple for quite a while, said, “We expect Apple to report an in-line March quarter, but are cautious into earnings on May 1 due to our belief that June quarter consensus estimates need to be revised lower.” Morgan Stanley has lowered its estimate for iPhone unit shipments to 34 million from 40.5 million. It was also recently revealed through unverified reports that Apple is reportedly planning to use more OLED panels for this year’s iPhone refresh but with LG perhaps not being able to make enough panels, Apple would have to go with Samsung panels which are more expensive. This could lead to a higher price for the iPhone which already cost about $1,000. Apple is expected to report fiscal second quarter results on May 1st. 
Access RDI’s Apple Inc. Research Report at: https://rdinvesting.com/news/?ticker=AAPL 
Twitter, Inc. shares closed up 1.17% on nearly 35 million shares traded on Friday. The stock soared an impressive 11% last week after Morgan Stanley had some bullish things to say about the social media company. Analyst Brian Nowak of the firm upgraded his rating on Twitter from “underweight” to “overweight” and cited improving user growth and ad sales. It was then on Friday that MKM Partners analyst Rob Sanderson had upgraded his rating on Twitter shares from “neutral” to “buy” and gave the stock a $40 price target. According to Sanderson, it is improved monetization and user growth that sparked his upgrade. Twitter is expected to report their first quarter report on Wednesday, April 25, ahead of the bell. Analysts are waiting for revenue of $605.3 million, a 10% increase, and a profit of $0.11 a share. Expected profit is quite an improvement from just $0.07 a share reported in same period last year.
